content: FastAPI 0.137.1 (Jun 15 2026) latest on PyPI; CLAUDE.md says 0.136 which is close to current. Use latest stable from 0.136/0.137 series. FastAPI lifespan context manager for startup events is the modern pattern (not @app.on_event deprecated). SQLAlchemy 2.0 async engine uses create_async_engine with postgresql+asyncpg URL. async_sessionmaker replaces sessionmaker for async. Alembic migrations run before uvicorn via Docker command: bash -c 'alembic upgrade head && python -m uvicorn main:app'. Project structure: src/api/main.py, src/api/db.py, src/api/settings.py, src/api/models/, src/api/routes/. Pydantic settings v2 via pydantic-settings package.
